notes: PPSSPP (PSP): the official anylinux AppImage, built with pkgforge's quick-sharun (bin/PPSSPPSDL is sharun; its assets are bin/assets, found through /proc/self/exe). Its path-mapping hook is a .src.hook; the link it makes is unused.

--fullscreen; the ROM boots straight into the game (no game list). --pause-menu-exit: Exit in the pause menu (Select + Start, controls.ini) quits PPSSPP, so OpenGamepadUI gets the panel back. SIGTERM quits cleanly, no dialog.
gui_args: PPSSPP's own pad-driven UI (no --pause-menu-exit there, or ending a game would quit the app).

gamepad_profile guide-hotkeys.yaml: hold Guide for L1 load state, R1 save state (the current slot), R2 fast-forward, Start quit — as keyboard F1-F4, bound in the seeded controls.ini [ControlMapping] (Load State, Save State, Fast-forward, Exit App). Exit App is PPSSPP's clean quit, the same as the pause menu's Exit with --pause-menu-exit; Select + Start (pause menu) stays.

achievements: the player's one RetroAchievements sign-in and Hardcore toggle, written at every launch (plan standalone-cheevos): ppsspp.ini [Achievements], the token alone in PSP/SYSTEM/ppsspp_retroachievements.dat (PPSSPP's NativeSaveSecret), removed when signed out. AchievementsChallengeMode defaults to True in PPSSPP: always written.
